title: Hear me out: Virgo's label maker
old_caption: Sag pitches Virgo's label maker to a very skeptical front row: the keys have a home, the snacks are alphabetized. Then Virgo prints one more label, for Sag. Who would you let label you?

title: Hear me out: someone who says I'll walk you to your car
old_caption: Cancer's unpopular crush opinion: someone who walks you to your car. Even when it's parked right there. Even when you took the bus. The front row did not survive. Green flag or too much?

title: They clap when the plane lands
old_caption: Sagittarius claps for the landing, the baggage belt and their own suitcase, and by the end Capricorn is clapping too. That's not an ick, that's a lifestyle. What should be an ick but isn't for you?

title: They wave at every dog
old_caption: Aries waves at every dog. Dogs on walks, dogs in cars, and then three dogs wave back in perfect unison. Even Scorpio quietly waved at the small one. Would you wave too?

title: They read the menu out loud, with voices
old_caption: The soup of the day, read like opening night. A movie-trailer voice for the breadsticks. And now the next table has turned their chairs around for the dessert sequel. What's your date's best bit?

title: They run to catch up for a hug
old_caption: Cancer has never once walked toward a hug. Sprinting, after five minutes apart, popcorn flying. And now dignified Leo is running too. What's the not-ick you've fully adopted?

title: They say yummy at every bite
old_caption: Taurus says yummy at every bite. The pasta, plain toast, even Virgo's slightly smoking pancakes, and means it every time. What tiny habit of theirs won you over?

title: Saving the last bite
old_caption: Aquarius stepped away for five minutes and Leo guarded the last bite of cake with a tiny flag that said YOURS. The hardest five minutes of Leo's life. Could you have held out?

title: Charging their phone without asking
old_caption: Sag at 2 percent, Virgo at 4, one charger. Cue a very quiet mission past a creaky floorboard. Sag woke up at 100 with a sticky note. Virgo's phone died happy. Tag your charger thief.

title: Text me when you get home
old_caption: Capricorn is totally not waiting up. Totally. Just peeking at the phone every few minutes until 11:26, then asleep in one second flat. Who's your text-me-when-you-get-home person?
